emails.subject: Update on your order 28e5c316
emails.body:
Hello,

We are very sorry for the issue with your order placed on 23 August 2018. This delay was caused by severe weather affecting freight leaving Sao Paulo.

Since your order originally promised for 31 August 2018 will not be delivered, we are offering a free cancellation with a full refund of R$ 147.62.

Reply to this email to confirm the cancellation, or to keep the order if you still want it.

Thank you for your patience,
Customer Care Team

emails.subject: Update on your order 00063b38
emails.body:
Hello,

We sincerely apologize for the delay with your order of fashion bags accessories purchased on 27 July 2018.

Severe weather affecting freight leaving Sao Paulo caused the delay from the originally promised delivery date of 7 August 2018. To resolve this, we have arranged free expedited shipping through an unaffected route, and your new delivery date is 9 August 2018.

You do not need to do anything. The new route is already booked.

Thank you for your patience,
Customer Care Team

emails.subject: Update on your order 1b0bc119
emails.body:
Hello,

We sincerely apologize for the delay with your order of computers and furniture decor purchased on 14 August 2018. The delivery has been delayed due to severe weather affecting freight leaving Sao Paulo.

Your new delivery date is 28 August 2018. As a resolution, your freight charge of R$ 75.45 has been refunded.

You do not need to do anything. The refund is automatic.

Thank you for your patience,
Customer Care Team

executive_summary: A weather disruption delays freight leaving the state of Sao Paulo (SP) by 5 days, hitting 7,037 orders and 922 sellers. Out of the total orders, 2,268 orders will be late, averaging 4.2 days late. The disruption affects 7,959 items and 7,037 customers, with the most affected categories being bed bath table, health beauty, and housewares. The rules decided 4,769 orders for R0 MONITOR, 59 orders for R1 CANCEL, 96 orders for R2 DELAY, 1,389 orders for R3 REROUTE, and 724 orders for R4 DELAY. The value of late orders is R$ 241,748.63 with an estimated compensation cost of R$ 36,976.82.
recommendations: Contact seller 6560211a and seller 1025f0e2 first as they have the highest volume of affected orders.
Book extra carrier capacity in sao paulo and guariba to manage the rerouted shipments.
Prepare operations for processing refunds and cancellations for the 59 orders under R1 CANCEL.
Review the 429 orders flagged for human review focusing on high-value critical items.
